{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Ah! I see you enjoyed the moodsetter enough to display it.|Thaymes Fodrick, disguised as Thadley Biolan, to Ledina Chott|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
A '''moodsetter''' was a decorative device featuring a crystalline [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] housing with flowing bars in different colors. It was displayed atop an end table in a room and was apparently intended to create or enhance a particular mood.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Thaymes Fodrick]] entered the home of popular pop [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Ledina Chott]] located in [[Tiara Ridge estates]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. Fodrick wore a [[neoglith masquer]] that bore the likeness of "Thadley Biolan," the new identity that Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] was using to court Chott and send her gifts. One of the gifts he sent her was a moodsetter, which she displayed in her social room. Fodrick, in his disguise as Biolan, commented that he was delighted she was enjoying his gift.<ref name="MK" />
